control_failures.control_label: controlled removal of isolation and return to service
proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: near hit during a breakdown response on P-3222

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ISOLATION_HANDBACK_CONTROL: the controlled removal of isolation and return to service had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the proving zero energy before intrusive work on P-3222 and PT-3222 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in applying and verifying an isolation, specifically dissipating trapped and residual energy. P-3222 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the controlled removal of isolation and return to service had been bypassed. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 19 February 2007 a near hit was recorded on P-3222 and PT-3222 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a breakdown response; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
